html: I. קבב (√ of foll.; cf. Arabic قُبَّةٌ arch, dome (hence ‘al-cove’), vaulted tent, especially tent of honour GoldziherZMG xlvii (1893), 74 f. JacobBeduinenleben (2) 86, 245; Syriac ܩܒܳܒܳܐ vault, dome, ܩܽܘܒܬܳܐ id., vaulted tent PS3466 b; so NH קוּבָּה, specif. lupanar; 𝔗 קוּבְּתָא vault (especially vaulted heavens); perhaps also Assyrian ḳabâbu, shield).
